items.quote: For the LORD had spoken unto Moses, saying,
Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:
items.claim: The tribe of Levi should not be numbered among the children of Israel

items.quote: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it:
items.claim: The Levites should be appointed to oversee the tabernacle of testimony and all its contents

items.quote: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.
items.claim: The Levites shall carry the tabernacle and vessels, minister to it, and camp around it
items.object: the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof
